shard: Germany: every pending row of scripts/data/rosterConfirmation2026.json whose club plays in the Bundesliga or the 2. Bundesliga (51 rows at origin/main 5f2622fd)
method: Each row was read on the web on 2026-10-02. A row leaves pending only when an official page (family A: bundesliga.com squad page for the club in question, a club's own squad page or announcement, or a league's own squad page) and an independent publisher on another host (family B: Soccerway, FotMob, ESPN) agree where the man is. Birth dates are in the note so a namesake cannot be mistaken for him. A season-long loanee is placed at the club he plays for, with loan and loanFrom as information only, the ledger's loanPolicy. The to field is the Club Manager club name the bake knows; realClub is the club as the sources write it. This file is folded into rosterConfirmation2026.json by the lead; nothing reads it directly.
forTheFold: Every one of the 51 rows is settled; none is left pending. Read before folding: (1) four movedTo or removed rows rest on family A only for the departure, because the destination club's own page would not load, and on two or more independent publishers for where the man is now: Marvin Ducksch, Oladapo Afolayan, Andreas Skov Olsen and Joel Vega Zambrano; Michy Batshuayi and Mahmoud Dahoud are the same shape (Batshuayi's club confirmation is quoted by hessenschau, Dahoud's destination is medium confidence and the UAE is not modelled either way). (2) Three notCurrent rows are unattached free agents at medium confidence and should be re-checked at the next adjudication: Maximilian Philipp, Rabbi Matondo, Pascal Stenzel. Niklas Suele is notCurrent because he retired. (3) Two rows carry information-only loan fields: Tomas Cvancara (removed, at Hradec Kralove on loan from Gladbach) and Andreas Skov Olsen (moved to Basaksehir on loan from Wolfsburg); Louey Ben Farhat stays at Karlsruhe on loan back from Freiburg. (4) Every to value is a club name the bake knows, checked against the 368 clubs of src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts at origin/main 5f2622fd, and every one of the 51 names appears exactly once in that file, so no namesake is involved.
